findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "book-creation" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job_status · Public sink: upload_image, list_my_characters, save_my_character, create_coloring_book, create_story_coloring_book, create_illustrated_story_book, create_cover_photo · Destructive: save_my_character.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job_status · Public sink: upload_image, list_my_characters, save_my_character, create_coloring_book, create_story_coloring_book, create_illustrated_story_book, create_cover_photo · Destructive: save_my_character

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
